name: autovacuum_naptime
description: Time interval between successive autovacuum launcher process wakeups to check for tables needing vacuum or analyze.
symptoms: Bloat accumulation in heavily updated tables
Query performance degradation due to outdated statistics
Increased disk usage from unreclaimed dead tuples
tuning_tips: Decrease naptime (e.g., to 10–30 s) on busy OLTP systems with frequent updates to prevent bloat and stale stats; increase it (e.g., to 120–300 s) on low-traffic systems to reduce launcher overhead.
